# Mac shortcuts in a folder window, through the copy of KeyFlip that is running (turn
# its Mac shortcuts on first). Make an empty folder kfcheck-outer with one empty folder
# kfcheck-inner in it, open kfcheck-outer in File Explorer, then:
#
#   dist\KeyFlip.Tests.exe --external "kfcheck-outer" tests\external\mac-explorer.txt --installed
#
# Nothing is deleted or renamed. The window is closed at the end.
show
# Select the only item, open it, and go back to the folder above.
key:down
key:alt+down
front:kfcheck-inner
key:alt+up
front:kfcheck-outer
# Close the tab, and with it the window.
key:alt+w
wait:700
